skills.detail:
A close-range attack.

When Counter Succeeds:
If enemy attacks within a set period of time, deals a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect.

When Counter Fails:
If the enemy does not attack within a set period of time, deals a mid-range attack.

Attack has a high Critical hit chance.
Attack ignores obstacles.
Become temporarily invincible after use.
